background: Handelsbanken plc is the UK subsidiary of Svenska Handelsbanken, running a network of local branches that lend to UK businesses, professionals and homeowners under the parent's decentralised model, funded by UK deposits and the parent.
synthesis: Ratings are among the highest of any UK bank: AA+ from Fitch after the upgrade on 12 May 2026 and AA- from S&P, both stable, on the strength of the Swedish parent. Capital is strong against UK mid-sized banks, with CET1 of 17.5% and leverage of 9.4% both in the top quarter against medians of 13.9% and 7.4%. Liquidity is mixed: LCR of 180% is above the 172% median while NSFR of 130% is below 135%. Since 31 Dec 2022 CET1 has fallen 3.8 points and LCR 132 points, so a large surplus has been run down, and the figures run to 31 Dec 2025. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
